title: The Two Hearts
label: ch:ml-two-hearts
canDo: I can name my heart in Malayalam two ways, one Sanskrit and one native, and say which one everyday idiom actually uses and why hridayam is a genuine cousin of the English word heart.

payoff.summary: Name hridayam and nenchu, place nenchidippu beside the santosham/nandi pattern from Chapter 2, and trace hridayam's root to the same PIE ancestor as English heart.
